units.source_text: 二月十六日春分，是个黄道吉日。

en.t: The spring equinox fell on the sixteenth day of the second month, an auspicious day.

units.source_text: 据阴阳师勘查报道，十六日前后都无好日子。

en.t: According to the diviners' investigation, there were no other favorable days around the sixteenth.

units.source_text: 此时太君的病正值好转。

en.t: At this time, the lady's illness was just beginning to improve.

units.source_text: 源氏便赶紧准备着裳仪式。

en.t: Genji therefore hurried to prepare the ceremony of donning the ceremonial skirt.

units.source_text: 他照例来到玉鬘房中，详细告诉她：前日如何向内大臣言明；行仪式时应有何种注意事项。

en.t: As usual, he went to Tamakazura's room and told her in detail how he had explained matters to the Inner Minister the day before, and what she should keep in mind during the ceremony.

units.source_text: 玉鬘觉得他这一片诚心，比生身父亲更加亲切，心中不胜喜悦。

en.t: Tamakazura felt that his sincere devotion was even warmer than that of her own birth father, and her heart overflowed with joy.

units.source_text: 此后源氏又把玉鬘的实情悄悄地告诉了夕雾中将。

en.t: After that, Genji quietly told Lieutenant General Yugiri the truth about Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 夕雾恍然大悟：“原来事情这样奇离！

en.t: Yugiri suddenly understood: "So that is how strange the matter really was!

units.source_text: 怪不得大风那天我窥见那种景象。”

en.t: No wonder I glimpsed such a scene on the day of the great wind."

units.source_text: 他觉得玉鬘的相貌比他所苦恋的云居雁更加美丽，便出神地回想她的面影，深悔以前没有想到，不曾向她求爱，真乃迂阔之至。

en.t: He thought Tamakazura's beauty surpassed even that of Kumoi no Kari, whom he loved so painfully, and he fell into a daze recalling her face, deeply regretting that he had never thought of courting her before and had been so terribly obtuse.

units.source_text: 然而他又觉得对云居雁变节，乃忘情负义之事，便又打消此心。

en.t: Yet he also felt that changing his heart toward Kumoi no Kari would be faithless and ungrateful, so he dismissed the thought.
Such loyalty in him was truly worthy of admiration.
